scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/docking-visible-solid-current.opd` is open with its solid visible in the MCAD Software
the viewport navigation bar is visible
the user selects Pan on the navigation bar
Pan is active
the Pan control is highlighted
the status area prompts the user to pan the current view and indicates cancellation is available
the active part and solid remain visible
the user presses Escape
the status area returns to Ready
the active part and solid remain visible

scenarios.name: Cancel Pan by clicking the viewport

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/docking-visible-solid-current.opd` is open with its solid visible in the MCAD Software
Pan is active from the viewport navigation bar
the user clicks an empty area of the viewport without dragging
Pan ends and the status area displays Ready
the same part and solid remain visible in their previous view

scenarios.name: End Pan using its context menu

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/docking-visible-solid-current.opd` is open with its solid visible in the MCAD Software
Pan is active from the viewport navigation bar
the user right-clicks an empty area of the viewport
a contextual menu offers Done, OK, Home View, Orbit, Zoom and Previous View
the status area still indicates Pan is active
the user chooses Done
the contextual menu closes and the status area displays Ready
the same part and solid remain visible

scenarios.name: Switch from Pan to Zoom using the contextual menu

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/docking-visible-solid-current.opd` is open with its solid visible in the MCAD Software
Pan is active from the viewport navigation bar
the user right-clicks an empty area of the viewport
the user chooses Zoom from the contextual menu
the contextual menu closes
the status area prompts for zooming and indicates cancellation is available
the same part and solid remain visible
the user presses Escape
the status area returns to Ready
